    Check whether the secure server-only Sandbox configuration is ready. Checkout remains disabled.

    Not Checked

    This status check never creates a customer, card, payment, or charge.

    Checking for an existing unexpired isolated test. No charge or payment is created automatically.

    Issue New $1 Sandbox Test

    Creates one isolated server-priced $1.00 test record only. It does not open a card form or contact Square.

    No Ready Test

    Two-step confirmation is required. Checkout remains disabled.

    Resume Existing Sandbox Test

    Reopens the one existing isolated $1.00 Sandbox test. It never creates another charge or touches family billing.

    Not Checked

    Confirmation is required before the secure Square Sandbox form loads. No payment is submitted automatically.
